notes: Lower thirds can now use Bebas Neue, the UN video typeface, as well as OCHA Raleway. Pick it in Advanced settings > Font - before you place, or on a lower third you have already placed. Raleway stays the default and nothing changes unless you choose it; in Bebas both lines are capitals, as UN video style has them. The old Position panel is now Advanced settings, holding Position and Font, and the readability gradient and vignette let you choose which track they land on instead of always deciding for you.
